name: Notion

tools.title: Check Notion tool access
tools.description: Read connection tool availability and parameter restrictions before searching or using plan-dependent tools.

tool_names.description: Optional RunTool names to include, such as search and ai_search. Omit to return all tools visible to this connection. Unknown or unexposed names are omitted. An empty list returns an empty map.

tools.title: Fetch Notion content
tools.description: Fetch one reviewed Notion object or the special self identity record.

id.description: The ID or URL of the Notion page, database, or data source to fetch. Supports notion.so URLs, Notion Sites URLs (*.notion.site), raw UUIDs, and data source URLs (collection://...). Pass a notion://docs/* URI to read that documentation resource.

include_transcript.description: Whether to include meeting note transcripts. Defaults to false. When true, full transcripts are included; when false, a placeholder with the meeting note URL is shown instead.

include_discussions.description: Whether to include discussion/comment indicators in the page output. When true, adds a <page-discussions> summary with discussion count, preview snippets, and discussion:// URLs. Use with the get_comments tool to retrieve full discussion content. Defaults to false.

tools.title: Search Notion
tools.description: Before searching, call notion-get-tool-access with {} and use its current_tool_access map to check search routing and restricted parameters. Search accessible Notion workspace content or users; plan-dependent filters may be dropped with notices.

query.description: Short, specific keywords for Notion content search. For user search, enter a name or email address. Provide a non-empty query unless intentionally browsing with filters or a non-relevance sort.

query_type.description: Specify type of the query as either "internal" or "user". Always include this input if performing "user" search.

data_source_url.description: Optionally restrict keyword search to a data source URL returned in a <data-source> tag.

page_url.description: Optionally restrict keyword search to a page and its descendants. Accepts a Notion page URL or ID.

teamspace_id.description: Optionally, provide the ID of a teamspace to restrict search results to. This will perform a search over content within the specified teamspace only. Accepts the teamspace ID (UUIDv4) with or without dashes.

filters.description: Optional exact filters for Notion workspace search. Omit unless required by the request. Keep filter fields nested here; do not send them at the top level. Some filters require Business access.

created_date_range.description: Optional filter to only produce search results created within the specified date range.

start_date.description: The start date of the date range as an ISO 8601 date string, if any.

end_date.description: The end date of the date range as an ISO 8601 date string, if any.

created_by_user_ids.description: Optional filter to only produce search results created by the Notion users that have the specified user IDs.

edited_by_user_ids.description: Optional filter to only produce search results edited by the Notion users that have the specified user IDs. Available on the Business plan.

last_edited_date_range.description: Optional filter to only produce search results last edited within the specified date range. Available on the Business plan.

start_date.description: The start date of the date range as an ISO 8601 date string, if any.

end_date.description: The end date of the date range as an ISO 8601 date string, if any.

teamspace_ids.description: Optional filter to only produce search results inside one of the specified teamspaces. Selecting more than one teamspace is available on the Business plan; use teamspace_id for one teamspace on other plans.

title_only.description: When true, match the query only against page and database titles instead of page content. Available on the Business plan.

content_status.description: Which pages to include by status. Omit for the default live pages. Supplying this field, even with the default value, requires Business access.

sort.description: Result ordering for Notion workspace search. Omit for the default "relevance" ordering. "last_edited" and "created" require Business access.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10). Lower values reduce response size.

max_highlight_length.description: Maximum character length for result highlights (default 200). Set to 0 to omit highlights entirely.

verificationNotes: Staged from an owner-consented OAuth tools/list capture of 45 definitions; only three read-only tools are cataloged with exact observed input schemas. get-tool-access is the documented read-only prerequisite for search routing and plan restrictions. Read-only search and get-tool-access probes returned isError:false; search result shape and count and end-to-end application invocation are unverified. The formerly cataloged create-pages and update-page tools are omitted: their captured schemas contain anyOf and propertyNames, unsupported by the pinned application argument validator; update-page now also requires command. No production publication, Store, or invocation acceptance is claimed.
